name: Engr. Wale Osamiluyi
title: Founder
bio: Wale founded Sato in 1997 and is responsible for the overall running of the company. He is an electrical engineer by training and has grown the firm from a start-up into a fully indigenous Nigerian engineering business.
qualifications: BEng Electrical Engineering, University of Ilorin, Nigeria
MSc Project Management, University of Cape Town, South Africa
MBA Global Business, Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, Canada
Global Executive MBA, University of St. Gallen, Switzerland
memberships: Registered member, Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN)
Member, Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS)
Fellow, Institute for Government Research and Leadership Technology
yearsExperience: Over 39 years of engineering experience {{CONFIRM: 39 years recalculated from "over 25 years" on the 2012 site}}
